18.t: Working with data: a socket survey
q: Which appliance has the largest power?
Calculate the current for the kettle with I = P / V.
Calculate the total current if all four run at once.
Evaluate whether it is safe to run all four on this lead, and recommend what to do.
No: 18 A is far over the 10 A rating, so the lead would overheat (fire risk). Run the kettle on its own wall socket, or only use one high-power appliance at a time.
